svg.text: D3: Disaster Management & Agro-Climatic Resilience Engine
SIH 2026 Theme: Disaster Management · Four Graded Early-Warning Risk Indices (0–100) with Autonomous Field Interventions
DISASTER THEME
1. DROUGHT DEFICIT INDEX (0–100)
SOIL & RAIN DEFICIT
Mathematical Formulation & Input Telemetry:
• Capacitive Soil VWC (%) trajectory over 72 hours
• Open-Meteo 7-day cumulative precipitation forecast vs. historical ETc
• Soil texture water retention capacity from ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0
Autonomous Edge Interventions & Farmer Action:
1. Pre-emptive Irrigation Pulse: Triggers deep root-zone wetting before canal shutdown.
2. Mulching Alert: Dispatches Hindi SMS advising organic mulch to cut soil evaporation.
3. Anti-Transpirant Advisory: Recommends 2% Kaolin spray to conserve canopy moisture.
2. FLOOD & WATERLOGGING RISK (0–100)
DELUGE & HYPOXIA
Mathematical Formulation & Input Telemetry:
• FC-37 Rain sensor state fused with high-rate rainfall forecasts (>50mm/24h)
• Capacitive sensor voltage < 1.30V (indicates complete soil saturation / pooling)
• Topographic parcel drainage factor from Digital Elevation Models (DEM)
Autonomous Edge Interventions & Farmer Action:
1. Instant Pump Hardware Lockout: Software and hardware inhibit relay closure.
2. Trench Drainage Alert: Audio alarm and SMS to clear field discharge channels.
3. Root Hypoxia Guard: Nitrogen top-dress postponement to prevent nitrate leaching.
3. CANOPY HEATWAVE STRESS (0–100)
THERMAL ANOMALY
Mathematical Formulation & Input Telemetry:
• DHT22 dry-bulb temperature sustained > 38°C for > 3 consecutive hours
• Atmospheric Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD = es - ea > 2.5 kPa)
• Crop phenology stage sensitivity (flowering / grain-filling critical threshold)
Autonomous Edge Interventions & Farmer Action:
1. Schedule Shifting: Inhibits midday watering; schedules irrigation at 04:00 AM.
2. Canopy Cooling Pulse: Triggers short 3-minute overhead micro-sprinkler misting.
3. Flower Abortion Warning: Warns tomato/cotton growers of pollen sterility risks.
4. DISEASE OUTBREAK EPIDEMIC INDEX (0–100)
EPIDEMIC TRIAGE
Mathematical Formulation & Input Telemetry:
• Sustained Relative Humidity (RH > 85%) for > 12 hours (leaf-wetness proxy)
• Temperature trapezoid matching ICAR pathogen spore sporulation ranges
• Targets: Wheat Yellow Rust (10-18°C), Rice Blast (20-28°C), Late Blight (12-22°C)
Autonomous Edge Interventions & Farmer Action:
1. Pre-Spore Spray Window: Identifies optimal 4-hour window before rain spreads spores.
2. Prophylactic Biopesticide: Advises Trichoderma / Neem spray before visible lesions.
3. KVK Escalation: Auto-packages temperature/RH history for district KVK scientist.
DISASTER ESCALATION ARCHITECTURE — GUARANTEED WARNING DELIVERY WITHOUT INTERNET
LEVEL 1: LOCAL FIELD ACTUATION
Autonomous pump veto, LED warning strobe, buzzer.
Requires zero connectivity · Runs on internal battery.
LEVEL 2: FARMER TELEPHONY (SMS)
SIM800L sends Devanagari Hindi SMS to registered phone.
Operates over 2G voice channel during 4G data blackouts.
LEVEL 3: PANCHAYAT & KVK DISPATCH
LoRa 868MHz packet relays hazard code to Village Gateway.
Escalates severe outbreaks to 18-Hub ICAR-KVK network.
